title: Coefficient presentation identifies the bounded finite-Tor generator predicates
statement: Let B be a finite discrete commutative topological ring, X a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme], and eR a monoidal isomorphism from the constant lifted B-ring on profinite sets to its continuous-function condensed ring [lem-weil-pbc-finite-discrete-condensed-ring-constant]. Put A=ULift B. Let P consist of bounded constructible etale coefficient-model complexes with a finite coefficient-model Tor interval [def-pe-etale-constructible-module, det-pe-finite-tor-comparison-noetherian], and Q the analogous pro-etale coefficient-model predicate. Use the explicit model realizations E and G [lem-ctf-finite-comparison-model-realization]. Then the replete image P.map D(E) is exactly the ordinary etale bounded constructible finite-Tor predicate, and Q.map D(G) is exactly the predicate that the specified internal realization has bounded constant-model constructible cohomology and finite Tor amplitude [lem-ctf-finite-comparison-coefficients, sk-def-sfb-constructible]. This concerns coefficient presentations separately on each site and does not assert any etale/pro-etale comparison.

proof.text: Use the exact coefficient-model equivalences and the specified internal realization. Under constant scalars, local finite module models agree with the sheafified constant-module construction. The same finite module and covering sieve give trivializations in both directions.

Apply these identifications on each locally closed stratum. A finite affine cover of a qcqs scheme and the global refinement of its local finite stratifications identify the affine-local convention with the global convention; pull back local models along the actual factorization morphisms. Finite B-modules are finitely presented over the Noetherian finite ring. Finite matrix presentations of point coefficient modules identify their pullbacks with these same constant finite models.

The scalar identifications are strong monoidal: the tensor comparison sends a pure tensor of the original sections to that same pure tensor and commutes with sheafification. Exactness and these comparisons transport bounded flat representatives in both directions. The coefficient-model flat-complex criterion therefore identifies the Tor predicates.

Exactness identifies homology and reflects its vanishing, hence preserves and reflects finite cohomological bounds. Essential surjectivity supplies representatives of every ordinary derived object; transport the predicates through the representative isomorphism to obtain the two replete-image equalities.

theorem finiteComparisonPresentation (X : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (eR : Sheaf.sheafifyRingPresheaf.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (coherentTopology Profinite.{u})
      ((Functor.const Profinite.{u}ᵒᵖ).obj (RingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} B))) ≅
        Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} B) [IsMonHom eR.hom] :
    let A := ULift.{u + 1} B
    letI : IsNoetherianRing A := inferInstance
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 2} (ConstantCompletion.Mod (ConstantCompletion.constant
        (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, u + 1} X) A)) :=
      HasDerivedCategory.standard _
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 2} (ConstantCompletion.Mod (ConstantCompletion.constant
        (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u + 1} X) A)) :=
      HasDerivedCategory.standard _
    let P : ObjectProperty (ConstantCompletion.D (ConstantCompletion.constant
        (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, u + 1} X) A)) :=
      fun K ↦ Scheme.IsCoefficientBoundedConstructibleEtale.{u, u + 1} X A K ∧
        ∃ a b : ℤ, HasCoefficientModelTorAmplitude _ K a b
    let Q : ObjectProperty (ConstantCompletion.D (ConstantCompletion.constant
        (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u + 1} X) A)) :=
      fun K ↦ coefficientBoundedConstructibleProEtale.{u, u + 1} X A K ∧
        Scheme.HasFiniteCoefficientProEtaleTorAmplitude.{u, u + 1} X A K
    P.map (finiteComparisonEtaleModelRealization X A).mapDerivedCategory =
        finiteComparisonEtaleGenerators B X ∧
    Q.map (finiteComparisonProEtaleModelRealization X A).mapDerivedCategory =
        finiteComparisonProEtaleGenerators B eR X
